reason: I always forget my pills at home, and one sachet I can toss in my bag is the first thing that actually fits my day. The named lab and a report for each batch is what I'd want to see, and $24.99 with a money-back promise is low enough to try one box.
objection: My drawer is full of half-used bottles. I'll probably quit after a week, and I don't know if the lab report is real or just a nice-looking PDF.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic, or the lab couldn't be looked up and checked, I'd skip it.
